# eon_idp_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of IDP (Identity Provider) groups and their role assignments in the Eon account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all IDP groups
data "eon_idp_groups" "all" {}

# Output group count and details
output "idp_group_count" {
  description = "Total number of IDP groups"
  value       = length(data.eon_idp_groups.all.groups)
}

output "idp_group_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all IDP groups"
  value       = [for g in data.eon_idp_groups.all.groups : g.id]
}

# Look up a specific group by provider_group_id
output "admin_group" {
  description = "The admin IDP group if present"
  value = try(
    [for g in data.eon_idp_groups.all.groups : g if g.provider_group_id == "00g1abc2def3ghi4j"][0],
    null
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) List of IDP groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) System-generated unique identifier for the IDP group.
- `idp_id` (String) The ID of the Identity Provider this group belongs to.
- `provider_group_id` (String) The group identifier from the Identity Provider.
- `role_ids` (List of String) List of Eon role IDs assigned to this IDP group.
